senses.sense_definition: iets formeel of persoonlijk aan iemand geven door het in diens handen te leggen

examples.text: De burgemeester zal de prijs persoonlijk aan de winnaar <w>overhandigen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The mayor will personally <w>present</w> the prize to the winner.
target_lang_translations.it: Il sindaco <w>consegnerà</w> personalmente il premio al vincitore.

examples.text: Hij <w>overhandigde</w> Sanne een brief die hij al weken bij zich droeg.

target_lang_translations.en: He <w>handed</w> Sanne a letter that he had been carrying with him for weeks.
target_lang_translations.it: Ha <w>consegnato</w> a Sanne una lettera che portava con sé da settimane.

examples.text: Tijdens de ceremonie mocht zij de sleutels <w>overhandigen</w> aan de nieuwe eigenaar.

target_lang_translations.en: During the ceremony, she was allowed to <w>hand over</w> the keys to the new owner.
target_lang_translations.it: Durante la cerimonia ha potuto <w>consegnare</w> le chiavi al nuovo proprietario.

target_lang_definitions.en: to formally or personally give something to someone by placing it in their hands
target_lang_definitions.it: dare formalmente o personalmente qualcosa a qualcuno mettendoglielo nelle mani

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to give something to someone physically or formally
to formally give something, like an award or gift
to hand over a letter or document

it.target_lang_sense_clarification: dare qualcosa a qualcuno in mano o formalmente
far pervenire una lettera o un documento
